crossRefs.note: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my…
Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.
Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will…
If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand…
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
(The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan…
In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

people.name: Amana
people.line: A mountain range mentioned in the Song of Solomon.

people.name: Hermon_Mount
people.line: Mountain on the northern border of Israel

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
translations.bsb: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, come with me from Lebanon! Descend from the peak of Amana, from the summits of Senir and Hermon, from the dens of the lions, from the mountains of the leopards.
translations.kjv: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
translations.asv: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, With me from Lebanon: Look from the top of Amana, From the top of Senir and Hermon, From the lions' dens, From the mountains of the leopards.
